name: fate-site
description: Waitlist site for Fate, at divineconstruc.com.

scripts.db:list: wrangler d1 execute fate-waitlist --remote --command="SELECT email, created_at, message FROM waitlist ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=fate-site
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=fate-site --branch=preview
